visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: White background; H2 'Explore' then three portrait-image cards with H3-sized title and short description, whole card linked.
visualCharacteristics.variantRationale: Three tall portrait-image cards, no borders, whole card linked
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Three tall portrait-image cards, no borders, whole card linked

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: [portrait image | heading with link, description]

blockContent.description: Three linked cards: About us, Partnerships, Get involved (image, title, description)

usage: Grid of three (or more) linked cards with tall portrait images, a heading link and a short description; the whole card is clickable.
reuseGuidance: Use for navigation cards to sub-sections. Put a link in the title so the whole card becomes a link. Use carousel-news for longer article lists.
